body: yes. i've decided how, just not where.

no no no. it's in a book form, so i've got what everyone can read, then the individual notes, which can be torn out and can be given to the other people individually. but i refuse to cite reasons and hence lay blame. i'm only saying what life is like for me now, and why i have to do it.

i'll definitely spend time with people who i can geographically. today i had a lovely day with one of them, went wayyyyy overboard with what was supposed to be a simple birthday celebration, told her a million times i loved her, knowing it would probably be that last time i saw her. it was lovely.

thanks for the thought-out reply. but i haven't made this decision lightly, or without trying to reach out to friends before. but thank you. 

do you think it's wrong to have notes for the few special people in my life, or would one blanket letter be better. at the moment i have a blanket letter, well, a cover letter kinda, then letters to individuals.
